title: TRUST IN GOD
PSALM 20:7 MIDDAY PRAYER
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon

scenes.a: You are staring at that bank balance right now, wondering how you will overcome.
scenes.sub: WHERE DO YOU PLACE YOUR TRUST

scenes.a: Scripture says, "Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God."
scenes.sub: WE REMEMBER THE NAME OF THE LORD

scenes.a: Lord, when financial pressures or human plans fail to secure our hearts, reorient our spirit toward You.
We lay down our reliance on self-made shields and temporary strength in this middle hour.
Anchor our mind in Your steadfast presence, knowing Your name carries more power than any worldly strategy.
scenes.sub: HIS NAME IS OUR STRONG TOWER

scenes.a: Guard our decisions today with divine wisdom, grace, and quiet confidence. Subscribe to pray with us every day at noon.
